amendment_reason: Assess class-conditioned geometry beyond class offsets, comparing enhanced candidates on calibration images only. No enhanced held-out result is consulted.
inputs: Only original 1000 calibration images, fixed cached boxes/classes/raw scores and their calibration GT

feature_definitions.additive: raw score, logit, class offsets, eight geometry features for SCG
feature_definitions.class_interactions: additive plus class×standardized score/logit; SCG additionally class×all eight standardized geometry features
feature_definitions.class_profile: additive; SCG adds eight absolute standardized deviations from fit known-TP class geometry profiles and their diagonal Euclidean distance
feature_definitions.interactions_profile: class interactions plus the same nine geometry profile features in SCG

matched_SC: Delete every geometry term and profile term; retain class×score/logit in interaction families
policy_grid: same 16 streams and anchors/cal-quantiles/max rule for each fitted model
objective: largest mean formal selection B across three splits; ties lower mean BG, then higher mean project AP, then fewer features and fixed family/C order
enhancement_acceptance: Enhanced family must exceed best additive family mean B by more than 1e-12; otherwise retain the additive family
uncertainty: three internal splits overlap; results are model selection diagnostics rather than independent replications
